key_points: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged a pause on frontier AI model development, triggering AI‑stock sell‑off.
Broadcom shares fell ~3.2% in pre‑market trading on 2026‑09‑14 amid the AI slowdown debate.
Motley Fool highlighted Anthropic as Broadcom’s next major customer after Google, a positive long‑term signal.
Analyst pieces compare Broadcom vs. Nvidia on AI chip strength, showing mixed views.
No new earnings guidance or material corporate news; movements driven by macro sentiment.
